gui: Off, Max score and Fewest moves presented; Fewest moves selected and saved through the launcher.
inspection: Read-only RAM/scoreboard inspection using the matching unstripped binary; no game-memory writes or injected seeks.
limitations: No physical ARM run. Fewest moves was stopped before its ending. Two emulator launches crashed during concurrent builds; the separate runtime run was stable. A subsequent DL2-only display guard and shared configuration extraction passed host checks and all four cross-builds.
